Maya Patel: Heads-up: coordinated marketplace launch timeline update. We need to align press embargo, partner co-announcement windows, hardware partner enablement, and SI integration dry-run.
Ethan Brooks: Timeline proposal: staging deploy Mon 09:00PT, partner dry-run Tue 11:00PT, press embargo Wed 15:00PT, public blog Wed 15:05PT, marketplace live Wed 15:30PT. Thoughts?
Rina Kapoor: LGTM but legal wants PR by Tue 18:00PT for review. If legal flags we slide the embargo to Thu 09:00PT.
Carlos Vega: Hardware partner asks for a 30-min walkthrough Tue 13:00PT (styling + CTA). They also requested a branded badge SVG. @Design - Noor please confirm asset handoff time.
Design - Noor: I'll deliver badge SVG + hi-res hero by Tue 10:00PT. Also localizations for en/us, en/uk, de, fr by Tue EOD.
Maya Patel: SIs need test tenants + sample API keys. Can ops provision two tenants by Tue 09:00PT?
OpsBot: Provision request received. Tentative tenants: si-tenant-a, si-tenant-b. ETA Tue 07:30PT. Credentials will be stored in Vault and shared to this channel.
Ethan Brooks: For launch cutover we should plan a 15-min CDN TTL drop 60 mins prior, then DNS swap. Sam?
Maya Patel: I'll coordinate with Sam in release-war-room during cutover.
Carlos Vega: Also prepping joint customer quote. Rina can you get legal to approve the quote by Tue EOD?
Rina Kapoor: On it.
Design - Noor: Quick note: mobile hero needs cropping for 9:16 in addition to desktop sizes. Delivering both.
Maya Patel: OK owners: Maya (program lead), Ethan (ops coordination), Rina (legal/PR), Carlos (partner liaison), Noor (creative), OpsBot (provisioning). I'll post a checklist doc and calendar invites. :rocket:
Ethan Brooks: Will run a smoke test after staging deploy and post results here.
OpsBot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled Mon 09:00PT.
